content.text: This clause set matches the preferred position.

input.quote: 8.2 Each Order Form has the initial term stated in it and thereafter renews for successive twelve-month periods unless Customer gives Vendor at least thirty days' written notice of non-renewal. Vendor shall remind Customer of an upcoming renewal at least sixty days beforehand.
input.rationale: § 8.2 provides automatic twelve-month (not multi-year) renewals with a Customer opt-out on only thirty days' written notice, plus a Vendor reminder at least sixty days before renewal — and a Customer-favourable extension of the opt-out deadline if the reminder is not sent. § 8.3 caps renewal uplift at the lesser of CPI and three percent, with ninety days' notice of any increase and no increase on prepaid periods. This satisfies the preferred position on renewal term, notice window (30 days ≤ 30) and price cap; no redline needed.
